parameters.name: substrate_youngs_modulus
parameters.justification: Epoxy primer (treated as rigid in the shear-lag model)

parameters.name: tie_zone_shear_modulus
parameters.justification: Effective (harmonic-mean) shear modulus of the graded zone; about 1e9 for a thin epoxy-like tie-coat

parameters.name: edge_shear_load
parameters.justification: In-plane membrane stress introduced at a cut edge by fender rubbing or cleaning

parameters.name: domain_length
parameters.justification: About 8 shear-lag decay lengths (sqrt(E_c*t_c*c_s) = 0.37 mm), so the far end is stress-free
